verdict.rationale: gstack skills live as SKILL.md files in per-skill folders (review/SKILL.md, qa/SKILL.md, and others) that are read from disk and symlinked into .claude/skills/. A host-config generator targets many harnesses (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot and more), and an AGENTS.md digest exists for hosts without a full install. Community reports confirm a git-clone-and-copy install model and one conversion into another agent format. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that skills are plain, harness-neutral markdown; clarity on how much the per-host generator transforms the files; and the fact that the browser tooling ships as a compiled CLI rather than markdown.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: It symlinks your repo into the local .claude/skills/ directory so Claude Code reads skills straight from your checkout.
